meta.title: OpenCode Go Quota
meta.description: An OpenCode Go quota tab for the right sidebar: the rolling 5-hour, weekly, and monthly windows with used and remaining share, reset countdowns, and the fixed $12 / $30 / $60 caps, opened from a card on the right Sidebar's guide page. The Host polls the OpenCode Go usage API, reusing DSH's own credential first; the key never reaches the browser.
